content: Standard fix for Flask+Werkzeug reloader double-invoking startup code (incl. background threads) is: if not app.debug or os.environ.get('WERKZEUG_RUN_MAIN') == 'true': start_thread(). This runs the thread unconditionally when app.debug is False (covers gunicorn production, which never sets WERKZEUG_RUN_MAIN and never uses the reloader) and only in the reloaded child process when debug+reloader are active, skipping the parent watcher process.
